WITH patient_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(l.ALB) as patient_avg_alb,
    AVG(CASE WHEN l.UN IS NOT NULL AND l.`T-BIL` IS NOT NULL AND l.`T-BIL` != 0 THEN CAST(l.UN AS REAL) / l.`T-BIL` ELSE NULL END) as patient_avg_ratio
  FROM Patient p
  INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
sex_stats AS (
  SELECT
    SEX,
    AVG(patient_avg_alb) as sex_avg_alb,
    AVG(patient_avg_ratio) as sex_avg_ratio
  FROM patient_stats
  WHERE patient_avg_alb IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY SEX
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(sex_avg_alb) as mean_alb
  FROM sex_stats
)
SELECT 
  s.SEX,
  s.sex_avg_alb,
  s.sex_avg_ratio,
  s.sex_avg_alb - o.mean_alb as alb_above_mean
FROM sex_stats s
CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
WHERE s.sex_avg_alb > o.mean_alb
